summary: Classification/scope direction confirmed (PII in, no card data; PDPD in, PCI/SBV out, ISO optional) but 4 edits required: reclassify DOB as Basic personal data (Decree 13/2023 Art.2.3), add missing Art.24 DPIA obligation, upgrade Art.25 cross-border transfer flag to firm obligation with per-vendor flows, add data-subject-rights/privacy-policy deliverable + chatbot sensitive-data minimization note

Revision resolves compliance findings: DOB reclassified to Basic personal data (Art.2.3); Art.24 DPIA dossier obligation added (R-12); Art.25 cross-border TIA upgraded to firm obligation with per-vendor table (R-04); privacy-policy + data-subject-rights promoted to PRD Epic H with Art.11 express/reproducible consent. compliance-checker verdict: CONFIRMED, no further loop needed.

G0 evidence complete and compliance-confirmed, but gate NOT passed: awaiting human sign-off by Product Owner + Risk/Compliance (business-case approval + acceptance of DPIA/TIA obligations). Not self-approved per SoD.

Gate G0 APPROVED by human (Product Owner + Risk/Compliance): business case confirmed and no legal blockers. All 5 G0 criteria met — risks ranked, compliance scope identified (PDPD in; PCI/SBV out; ISO optional), data classified (no card data, PII scoped, DOB basic Art.2.3). DPIA (Art.24, R-12) and cross-border TIA (Art.25, R-04) accepted as tracked obligations due before go-live, not intake blockers.

C-1 (R-16): cross-border redaction mis-ordered - free-text chat is sent to Anthropic BEFORE the redact/flag step, so incidental Art.2.4 sensitive data crosses the border un-mitigated (Art.25); storage-time redaction only sanitizes local DB. Fix: move redaction/classification to input side before ClaudeApiAdapter.createMessage; make Anthropic DPA no-training/zero-retention a blocking prerequisite.

H-1 (R-13): /api/chat denial-of-wallet - unauthenticated endpoint driving metered Claude API, rate-limit keyed on client-supplied rotatable sessionId+IP, cost only alerted not enforced. Fix: bot challenge (Turnstile), HMAC server-signed session tokens, server-side token/message caps, hard spend circuit-breaker failing to Zalo CTA; promote cost ceiling to FIRM enforced control.

H-2 (R-14): prompt-injection + client-forged assistant history - /api/chat trusts full client messages[] incl prior assistant turns, enabling guardrail bypass, false authenticity/price claims, and injection-forced handoff spam. Fix: server-authoritative conversation state, re-inject guardrails per turn, validate tool outputs, gate handoff lead creation.

H-3 (R-17): chatbot consent non-atomic (Art.11) - DOB/PII can be volunteered turn 1 and persisted/sent cross-border while ConsentRecord is only written at handoff and only if captured; ChatInput.consent is optional. Fix: make consent required in ChatInput; write session-scoped ConsentRecord at first PII-bearing turn before transcript persist/DOB use, mirroring the atomic lead-form path.

H-4 (R-15): DSR endpoint no requester identity verification - /api/dsr fulfils access/erasure/rectify keyed only on self-asserted phone/zalo/email; impersonator can exfiltrate a victim PII or destroy another subject record and Art.11 consent evidence. Fix: OTP/match-challenge to the on-record channel before any confidentiality- or integrity-affecting fulfilment; document as firm DsrService step + DSR SOP.

C-1 (R-16) RESOLVED - re-verified by threat-modeler: SensitiveInputScrubber.scrub() moved to input side before ClaudeApiAdapter.createMessage; strips Art.2.4 categories + Luhn-valid card strings; Anthropic no-training/zero-retention DPA made a blocking go-live prerequisite referenced by Art.24/25 dossiers. Residual (imperfect free-text scrubbing) documented as accepted risk in DPIA with the DPA as backstop.

H-1 (R-13) RESOLVED - re-verified by both reviewers: Turnstile bot challenge + HMAC server-signed non-rotatable sessionId + server-side per-session token/message caps + hard global spend circuit-breaker failing to Zalo; cost ceiling promoted to FIRM enforced control in nfr-targets §6.

H-2 (R-14) RESOLVED - re-verified: ChatInput requires [sessionToken,consent,userMessage] with additionalProperties false and no client assistant history; server-authoritative state; guardrail re-injected per turn; tool-output validation; handoff lead creation rate-limited/deduped per session.

H-3 (R-17) RESOLVED - re-verified: consent required in ChatInput; session-scoped ConsentRecord written on first PII-bearing turn before transcript persist/DOB use/cross-border call; CHAT_TRANSCRIPT.consent_id FK enforces link; mirrors atomic lead-form path.

H-4 (R-15) RESOLVED - re-verified: DsrService.verifyIdentifier sends OTP/match-challenge to on-record channel before any disclosive/mutating fulfilment; status received->pending_verification->verified; distinct human approver for fulfil() (P5 maker-checker); intake/ack stay open.

G1 evidence complete and both reviewers cleared (0 unresolved CRITICAL/HIGH; convergence loop resolved in 1 iteration; PCI boundary clean). Gate NOT passed: awaiting human sign-off by Architect + Security (ADR approval + architecture-review acceptance). Not self-approved per Maker-not-Checker / SoD.

Gate G1 APPROVED by human (Architect + Security). All 8 G1 criteria met: NFR targets defined, STRIDE threat model complete, sequence diagrams cover all 3 sensitive flows, ERD complete with PII flagged (no card data), architecture review passed, SoD + encryption at-rest/in-transit met, 5 ADRs approved, design walkthrough shows 0 unresolved CRITICAL/HIGH (1 CRITICAL + 4 HIGH fixed and re-verified; 1 accepted-risk with DPA backstop). PCI boundary clean.

DoR convergence check complete: 29 stories refined, 18 sprint-ready meet all 5 DoR criteria (clear/testable, data classified, security impact assessed, estimated, deterministic test approach - cross-confirmed by requirements-analyst backlog + test-engineer test-plan). 0 DoR failures, no revision loop needed. 3 stories explicitly DEFERRED with stated reasons: US-D3b (chatbot go-live, blocked on PO-1 spend-cap + PO-4 Anthropic DPA), US-H-COMP1 (DPIA owner PO-3), US-H-COMP2 (cross-border TIA owner PO-3 + PO-4).
